name: ZigZag
title: ZigZag: free Hatch alternative
caption:
Hatch Composer costs $699. ZigZag turns your artwork into embroidery for free 🧵

✅ Turns logos and drawings into stitches
✅ Fill, satin and run stitches, edited visually with a live preview
✅ Exports PES, DST, EXP, JEF and VP3 for your machine
✅ Sends designs straight to a Brother Skitch over Bluetooth

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ It's version 0.1, so expect rough edges, and its built-in AI helper needs Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity. Hatch has more, like built-in embroidery fonts and monogramming

Comment "STITCH" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

dm_pitch: ZigZag, the free open-source embroidery software 🧵

beats.say: Embroidery software costs seven hundred dollars. This one turns your art into stitches for free.
Hatch Composer is six ninety nine. ZigZag is zero.
Drop in a logo or a drawing, and it plans every stitch for you.
Press play, and it shows how your machine will sew it, stitch by stitch.
It saves designs for Brother, Janome and Husqvarna machines.
It's Hatch, minus the seven hundred dollar price tag.
Comment Stitch, and I'll send you the link.
